title: Blackberry and Brown Sugar Frozen Yoghurt
changes_from_base: Blackberries, dark brown sugar and a little clove are blended with unstrained yoghurt and sieved; brown sugar replaces the caster sugar and golden syrup.
summary: Blackberries blended with yoghurt, dark brown sugar and a hint of clove for a deep purple, caramel-edged frozen yoghurt.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend 340 g blackberries, 480 g full-fat plain yoghurt, 210 g dark brown sugar and ⅛ tsp ground cloves on high about 30 s until smooth.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Pour the mixture through a fine sieve, pressing with a ladle to remove the seeds.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir in ½ tsp finely grated lemon zest, then add 1 tbsp lemon juice and ¼ tsp fine salt a little at a time until balanced.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill the mixture until it reaches 4 °C or colder.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn the chilled mixture in your ice-cream maker with the bowl frozen 24 h.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Transfer to a lidded freezer container and freeze 4-5 h before serving.

tips: Press hard on the pulp in the sieve; most of the colour sits in the skins.
Frozen blackberries work well once thawed with their juice.
Go easy on the clove; a little more turns it medicinal.
storage: Keep in a lidded container in the freezer up to 5 days and soften 10-15 min at room temperature before scooping.
